results.title: Clean VM bootstrap without Node/npm; re-run preserves identity/admin/app state

toolsAfterBootstrap1.name: Cockpit
toolsAfterBootstrap1.note: Existing Cockpit installation bound without changes. Listener on port 9090 as configured by the host. Log in with an OS account. Login page reachable (HTTP 200). Uses a self-signed certificate; your browser will ask you to trust it.

toolsAfterBootstrap1.name: Portainer
toolsAfterBootstrap1.note: Portainer CE 2.39.7 with Docker socket access (root-equivalent). First run: create the admin in Portainer's own form within 5 minutes of start; it asks for the one-time setup token printed in the container log (sudo docker logs hb_platform_portainer-portainer-1 2>&1 | grep setup_token). If the window expired, run: sudo docker restart hb_platform_portainer-portainer-1 (prints a new token). Self-signed certificate. Login page reachable (HTTP 200). Uses a self-signed certificate; your browser will ask you to trust it.

toolsAfterBootstrap1.name: Tailscale
toolsAfterBootstrap1.note: Installed but not logged in (state NeedsLogin). Run: sudo tailscale up  (then approve the printed login URL).

toolsAfterBootstrap1.name: Public proxy (Caddy)
toolsAfterBootstrap1.note: Caddy admin API answering on 127.0.0.1:2019; routes are reconciled from Harbor state. Public exposure needs DNS records pointing at this host and ports 80/443 reachable.

notes: VM NOT rebuilt (--fresh not given); A01 evidence is from a re-used VM
